definitions.explanation: In baseball, the outfielder who covers right field. A strong throwing arm is valued because of the long throw to third base.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}がボールを{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: The right fielder throws the ball back.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}には{強|つよ}い{肩|かた}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A right fielder needs a strong throwing arm.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}が{塁上|るいじょう}の{走者|そうしゃ}を{刺|さ}した。
examples.english: The right fielder threw out the runner on base.

notes:
Compound of {右翼|うよく} (right wing) + {手|しゅ} (player). The outfielder who covers right field. Colloquially called ライト.

RELATED POSITIONS:
- {左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}: left fielder
- {中堅|ちゅうけん}{手|しゅ}: center fielder

Note that {右翼|うよく} on its own usually means the political right wing; {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ} is specifically the baseball position.
